edges.reason: msg.sender is captured and used to initialise the owner during construction.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Constructor calls setupBankrollInterface with the supplied bankroll address.
Constructor sets the max profit percent of house.
Constructor sets the minimum bet.
Constructor enables the game by setting gameActive to true.
setupBankrollInterface instantiates the Zethr interface state variable.
Bankroll list returned by the main bankroll is stored in UsedBankrollAddresses.
Each bankroll address is marked valid in ValidBankrollAddress.
execute forwards the token transfer into _spinTokens.
fromBankroll modifier validates msg.sender against ValidBankrollAddress.
_spinTokens writes the playerSpin struct into playerSpins.
_spinTokens increases the tracked contract balance for the tier.
_spinTokens increments totalSpins.
_spinTokens increments totalZTHWagered.
_spinTokens calls addContractBalance before settlement.
_spinTokens derives the spin tier through ZethrTierLibrary.getTier.
_spinTokens settles a previous unresolved spin before starting a new one.
finishSpin delegates the settlement to _finishSpin for msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the spin target passed from finishSpin.
playerSpins entry is nulled out before external calls to prevent re-entrancy.
_finishSpin generates the roll result via random.
_finishSpin reads the jackpot amount from the external jackpot contract.
_finishSpin calls payOutWinner on the external jackpot contract.
_finishSpin requests the player profit through RequestBankrollPayment.
RequestBankrollPayment performs the external gameRequestTokens call.
The external gameRequestTokens call can re-enter the settlement path.
The external payOutWinner call can re-enter the settlement path.
_finishSpin subtracts the profit from the tracked contract balance.
random delegates to maxRandom for the raw pseudo-random value.
Randomness is derived from blockhash of a chosen block plus an entropy address.
WithdrawToBankroll transfers the whole ETH balance to the bankroll.
WithdrawToBankroll reads the main bankroll from UsedBankrollAddresses.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll calls withdraw on the Zethr contract.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll then calls WithdrawToBankroll.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse recomputes maxProfit for every tier.
setMaxProfit performs unchecked multiplication and division on the balance.
getMaxProfit performs unchecked multiplication and division on the balance.
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse feeds the unchecked profit arithmetic.
contractBalance feeds the unchecked profit arithmetic.
The unchecked arithmetic result is stored into the maxProfit mapping.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens overwrites contractBalance from a bankroll-only path.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens refreshes maxProfit after the balance update.
fromBankroll modifier validates msg.sender for the balance update.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll modifier authorizes the ownership transfer call.
changeOwner writes the new owner address into owner.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll modifier authorizes the bankroll change call.
changeBankroll writes the new address into bankroll.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll modifier authorizes pausing the game.
pauseGame sets gameActive to false.
resumeGame sets gameActive to true.
onlyOwner modifier authorizes the minimum bet change.
ownerSetMinBet writes the new minimum bet.
onlyOwner modifier authorizes the jackpot address change.
ownerSetZlotsAddress writes the new jackpot address.
gameIsActive modifier gates settlement through the gameActive flag.
_spinTokens requires gameActive before storing the spin.
The stored playerSpin struct is read during settlement.
getTier output indexes UsedBankrollAddresses to select a bankroll.

Constructor parameter used to fetch the bankroll list.
Block number used as the blockhash randomness source.
Entropy address mixed into the pseudo-random hash.
Modulo bound parameter of the random helper.
Recipient of the requested bankroll token payout.
Token amount forwarded to the token bankroll.
Tier index used to select the bankroll address.
Original token sender copied into the TKN struct.
Token value copied into the TKN struct for the spin.
Memory copy of the player's spin struct read and nulled during settlement.
Payout amount computed inside the settlement function.
